_doc: FA1 first-person arms (src/fps_arms.cpp, docs/fps-arms.md). Each hand's pose on the weapon, in weapon space (x right, y up, z toward the muzzle): fwd = the direction from the wrist to the knuckles, palm = the palm's outward normal, contact = where the grip socket sits in the hand frame [along the fingers, toward the pinky, out of the palm] (m), curl = degrees toward the palm [proximal, distal] for fingers (middle to pinky) and index, thumb a single angle, soften = 0..1 how far the hand turns toward the forearm to keep the wrist straight. "weapons": per weapon id, keys replacing the default; left "free": true keeps the support hand off the weapon (one-handed). shoulderR / shoulderL: the shoulders (camera space: x right, y up, -z forward), behind and below the view so the arms reach out.
